prompt: Create a close-up vertical anime portrait of a youthful androgynous male character with pale skin, silvery gray layered hair, long bangs falling over one eye, and a small ahoge tuft rising from the crown. The character has vivid pink-magenta eyes with glossy highlights, a relaxed mischievous smile showing a small fang-like tooth, and soft cel-shaded facial rendering. He wears a dark black uniform or jacket collar with small metallic details, cropped tightly so only the upper shoulders and neck are visible. The background is plain white. Add visible generation-artifact-like horizontal stripe bands across the left side hair area, especially on the outer hair clump, while the central bangs remain smoother and more naturally rendered. Overlay a rough bright red handwritten annotation: one irregular red circle surrounding the problematic left hair clump, plus a small red arrow and messy Japanese note near the lower left reading この辺とくに?. Composition should be portrait format, face filling most of the frame, slightly cropped on the right edge and top, clean high-resolution anime illustration style with delicate gray hair shadows and pink eye highlights.

promptZh: 创作一张动漫角色特写竖版肖像，角色为一位年轻的中性化男性，拥有苍白的皮肤、银灰色 的层次感发型、遮住一只眼睛的长刘海，以及头顶翘起的一小撮呆毛。角色拥有一双生动的 粉洋红色 眼睛，带有光泽感高光，嘴角挂着轻松而顽皮的微笑，露出一颗小小的尖牙，面部采用柔和的赛璐珞风格渲染。他穿着深黑色制服或夹克领口，带有细小的金属细节，画面紧凑裁剪，仅露出上肩部和颈部。背景为纯白色。在左侧头发区域添加明显的类似生成伪影的水平条纹带，特别是在外侧发束上，而中央刘海保持平滑且自然的渲染效果。叠加粗糙的亮红色手写标注：用一个不规则的红色圆圈圈出有问题的左侧发束，并在左下角附近添加一个小红色箭头和潦草的日语注释，内容为 この辺とくに?。构图应为肖像格式，面部占据大部分画面，右侧边缘和顶部略有裁剪，呈现精致的高分辨率动漫插画风格，带有细腻的灰色发影和粉色眼部高光。
